acquisitions: Faiveley Transport S.A. (~51% of share capital / ~49% of voting shares from Faiveley family; consolidated under VIE model)
extra.notes: Employees: approximately 20,000 full-time at 12/31/2016. Faiveley Transport: on 30-Nov-2016 Wabtec acquired the Faiveley family stake (~51% of share capital, ~49% of voting rights) at EUR 100/share; aggregate value of consideration $978.1m = $534.7m stock (~6.3m Wabtec shares at $84.77) + $211.8m cash + $409.9m debt assumed - $178.3m cash acquired (10-K MD&A also cites 'our acquisition of a 51% controlling stake in Faiveley Transport for $746.5 million'). Preliminary PPA: goodwill $1,188.3m (Transit), trade names $333.8m, customer relationships $255.4m, NCI fair value $760.3m, net assets acquired $1,506.8m. Terms amended 24-Oct-2016 (term extended to 31-Dec-2016; no Wabtec preferred shares; 4.8-6.3m Wabtec shares to family). Tender offer for public shares launched Dec-2016 (EUR 100 cash or 1.1538 WAB shares per share); on 3-Feb-2017 initial tender closed adding 27.5% of share capital for ~$411.8m cash and $25.2m stock. Total price for 100% approx $1.7bn incl. assumed debt, net of cash; ~$1.0bn cash portion funded by cash on hand, $750m senior notes (2026 notes issued Q4-16), revolver and term loan. $744.7m held in escrow at 12/31/16 to fund the tender offer. Transaction/integration items 2016 (release): Faiveley transaction expenses ~$39m, contract adjustments and restructuring ~$16m, debt refinancing / pre-closing interest ~$24m; 10-K: Faiveley acquisition related costs $38.9m (SG&A), restructuring $5.4m (SG&A), Transit contract adjustments $13.8m (cost of sales), debt refinancing costs $14.9m (interest). Faiveley contributed $110.8m revenue, $0.6m operating income and a $30.6m net tax benefit in Dec-2016. 2016 share repurchases: 3,046,408 shares for about $212m. Purchase prices net of cash acquired.
